# Designing a serial protocol: framing, checksums, CRC: the exercise

<!-- Generated by tools/maintainer/build_exercise_readmes.py from the lesson page. Edit the lesson, then run the script. -->

Lesson: [Designing a serial protocol: framing, checksums, CRC](https://jouhis.github.io/embedded-course/lessons/0103-designing-a-serial-protocol.html). Read it first: the steps below refer to its diagrams and worked examples.

## Try it on the Pico: a framed sensor stream

The Pico project `projects/0103-framed-sensor-stream` sends frames that each carry a sequence number, a sensor ID, a 16-bit reading and a CRC, all COBS-encoded and ended by a zero, the six-byte body holding one sequence byte, one sensor ID byte (0x21), the reading as two bytes and the two CRC bytes, the reading being a temperature in hundredths of a degree, starting at 22.50 °C.

1. Open `projects/0103-framed-sensor-stream/starter` in VS Code, whose `frame_encode()` returns 0, so the serial monitor shows five lines like `FRAME seq=0 bytes=0:` with no bytes after them, then `ROUNDTRIP FAILED`.
2. In `main.c`, fill in `frame_encode()` following the comment, body, CRC, COBS and then the delimiter, and then `frame_decode()`, which COBS-decodes, checks the body length, checks that the CRC of all six bytes is zero and reads the fields back.
3. Build with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>B</kbd> and start the simulator with <kbd>F1</kbd> → *Wokwi: Start Simulator*, the changes having worked when each of the five `FRAME` lines is followed by bytes and the last line is `ROUNDTRIP OK`.

The starter's `main()` checks only that all five frames decode, whereas the reference solution in `projects/0103-framed-sensor-stream/solution` adds two things worth copying once your own version works, a `decoded seq=... value=...` line for each frame and a check that a frame with one byte flipped is rejected, which prints `corrupted frame rejected: yes` before the final line, the solution's output also ending with `ROUNDTRIP OK`.

We did not run the simulator for this lesson, because the workspace has no `WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN`, although the reference solution's logic was run on the PC, compiled against the same COBS and CRC files, with output ending in `ROUNDTRIP OK`, so the Wokwi run is the step to confirm. The reference solution is in `projects/0103-framed-sensor-stream/solution`, to be compared after you have tried.
